message: No real-data evaluation has been performed. The public Kaggle training set requires credentials and terms acceptance that are not configured locally, and its small/large versions are approximately 214 GiB / 1.2 TiB. No raw EDF recordings were downloaded or processed, and no model scores are claimed.
synthetic_data_policy: Synthetic fixtures are used only in automated software tests to verify algorithm behavior. They are never reported as clinical performance and never mixed into real-data metrics.
